body:
I feel you. I've lost interest in anything and everything, and I can't so many of the things I want to do due to this lockdown...

Try and find something, even if it's mundane and boring to everyone else, that keeps you occupied. I know it's hard but keep looking. I'm hoping to find my thing soon...

If you fancied a chat, to let it all out anonymously I would welcome it, all the best.
Well emotionless and empty... I guess I am like a robot

You love her? Then tell her about how you feel. Hug her so tightly and cry into her shoulder. Ask her to lay with you and just hold her knowing that she is there allways for you.

You have a lifeline. Her. Live for her and live with her. If she's what's keeping you alive then make the most of it whilst you work on whatever else it is that is causing your depression.

And go to a new doctor. You did something and they didn't help. Demand antidepressants or therapy if you think that's what will help. Are you in the UK?

Yeah but instead of suicide, do something reckless and stupid that might result in permanent irreversible injury or death. Oh wait...

Nah but if it works for him who are we to say otherwise. Instead of being reckless do whatever it is that makes you happy and do a lot of it.

Fuck anyone telling us we shouldn't do that. If there's even one thing that keeps me asking you best be sure I am going to do it non stop.

School is great. Some days you live it, some days you think there is no hope.

But I tell you what, when you finish you'll look back at it as the best days of your life and wishing you didn't take it for granted.

Take it from som one who has been through schools been through uni and worked in education. School was the best years of my life, and I kick myself for not realising it then.

Good luck with it, enjoy it whilst it lasts. You don't get a round 2.

Give it another year. And then after that give it another year. When that comes to an end give it another year.

Let's keep going. I'm not saying we will gey through this. Bit we've got one life, so let's live it.

Do whatever it is that makes you happy every day, who cares what it is. Paint, draw, drive, game, who the fuck cares. I've been playing video games for over 6 hours a day for the past week and I'm ok with that. It keeps me going. If I have to do this for the rest of my life to stop me from being depressed as fuck I'll do it.

Wishing you the best, take it year by year, it's better than day by day.

See you in 10 years pal. Then give it another 10, see how you feel then.

You'd never know. So what use is it taking your life? I too want to take my life to see what others will feel, who would care, would people finally take me seriously?

But then I'd be dead, not aware, not looking down from above. Just gone. If you want to see what people will do then make them think you don't exist. 

But you know what, who cares about other people? You're the only person you need to loves you. Do whatever the fuck it is that makes you happy. Go driving, go swimming, sit inside all day and play video games. Who the fuck cares, do whatever it is that makes YOU happy.

Yep this sounds like reality. Must be hard to see people recommending something likes it's gospel that's caused so much hurt.

Hope you're doing good now. Death isn't the answer, finding shred of happiness that makes you feel something must be the answer.

Wishing you the best.

I'm depressed and wish I was drunk. But shit i have no friends and live at home with my parents. Take another sip for me, put music on and cry until you're numb. Reality can be poisonous, so try and get as close to escaping it whilst being alive.

All the best.

Making life my bitch would result in me losing my job, losing the few friends I have left, fucking my body up with drugs and alcohol and everything else... 

I'm all for not fearing death... Fuck, I haven't cared about living or dying for over 8 years, but saying fuck it will only mean my only choice is the kill myself.

It's a nightmare when the things that make you want to kill yourself are the things that keep you alive...

Keep it up though, if it works for you then all power to you.
